subject: Medford and West Medford Square Rezoning
overview: The board opened a public hearing and discussed proposed zoning changes for Medford Square and West Medford Square, ultimately voting to continue the hearing to June 25, 2025. The board also voted to continue its neighborhood residential zoning hearing and received an informational briefing on other commercial transit corridors.

items.title: Neighborhood and Urban Residential Zoning Amendments Continuance
items.summary: The board voted to continue the public hearing for the neighborhood residential and urban residential zoning amendments to June 18, 2025, to preserve eligible voting members.

items.title: Medford Square and West Medford Square Zoning Amendments Public Hearing
items.summary: The board opened a public hearing on proposed mixed-use and transition zoning for Medford Square and West Medford Square, heard public feedback on building heights, shading, and parking, and voted to continue the hearing to June 25, 2025.

items.title: Presentation of Draft Zoning of Other Corridors
items.summary: The board received an informational presentation on draft zoning concepts for Boston Avenue, Main Street, Broadway, Harvard Street, and High Street corridors.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes of the April 2, 2025, and May 21, 2025, meetings.
